workflowInfo.workflowDefaultName: Zowe API Mediation Layer Health Probe
workflowInfo.workflowDescription: Probes the Zowe APIML gateway, discovery, and catalog services and writes a health report

variable.name: GATEWAY_VERSION
variable.label: Gateway Version
variable.abstract: Zowe API Gateway version string captured from /gateway/api/v1/info
variable.description: Filled by the probeGateway rest step via propertyMapping on the apiVersion field.

variable.name: GATEWAY_STATUS
variable.label: Gateway HTTP Status
variable.abstract: Actual HTTP status code returned by the gateway probe
variable.description: Filled by the probeGateway rest step via actualStatusCode. Expected value: 200.

variable.name: DISCOVERY_STATUS
variable.label: Discovery Service HTTP Status
variable.abstract: Actual HTTP status code returned by the discovery service probe
variable.description: Filled by the probeDiscovery rest step via actualStatusCode. Expected value: 200.

variable.name: SERVICE_COUNT
variable.label: Registered Service Count
variable.abstract: Raw application list captured from the Eureka /apps endpoint
variable.description: Filled by the probeDiscovery rest step via propertyMapping on applications.application. The count can be read from the number of entries in the captured value.

variable.name: CATALOG_STATUS
variable.label: API Catalog HTTP Status
variable.abstract: Actual HTTP status code returned by the API Catalog probe
variable.description: Filled by the probeCatalog rest step via actualStatusCode. Expected value: 200.

variable.name: CATALOG_COUNT
variable.label: API Catalog Container Count
variable.abstract: First catalog container ID captured from /apicatalog/api/v1/containers
variable.description: Filled by the probeCatalog rest step via propertyMapping on the first element's id field. Confirms the catalog returned at least one tile.

variable.name: HEALTH_SUMMARY
variable.label: Health Summary
variable.abstract: Derived one-line summary of all three probe results
variable.description: Built by the deriveStatus setVariable step from the three HTTP status variables. Used as the headline in the final health report.

step.name: probeGateway
step.title: Probe API Gateway
step.description: Calls GET /gateway/api/v1/info through z/OSMF and captures the gateway version and HTTP status code
step.instructions: Sends a GET request to the Zowe API Gateway info endpoint. On success (HTTP 200) the apiVersion field is captured into GATEWAY_VERSION and the actual status code into GATEWAY_STATUS. A non-200 response will cause this step to fail immediately.

step.name: probeDiscovery
step.title: Probe Discovery Service
step.description: Calls GET /eureka/apps to confirm the discovery service is reachable and captures the number of registered services
step.instructions: Sends a GET request to the Eureka applications endpoint routed through the Zowe API Gateway. On success (HTTP 200) the length of the applications.application array is captured into SERVICE_COUNT and the actual HTTP status into DISCOVERY_STATUS. A non-200 response will cause this step to fail.

step.name: probeCatalog
step.title: Probe API Catalog
step.description: Calls GET /apicatalog/api/v1/containers to confirm the catalog is reachable and captures the number of published API tiles
step.instructions: Sends a GET request to the API Catalog containers endpoint. On success (HTTP 200) the length of the top-level array is captured into CATALOG_COUNT and the actual HTTP status into CATALOG_STATUS. A non-200 response will cause this step to fail.

step.name: deriveStatus
step.title: Derive Health Summary
step.description: Builds a one-line HEALTH_SUMMARY string from the three HTTP status variables using setVariable
step.instructions: Constructs a summary from the values captured by the three probe steps: Gateway : ${instance-GATEWAY_STATUS} (version ${instance-GATEWAY_VERSION}) Discovery : ${instance-DISCOVERY_STATUS} (${instance-SERVICE_COUNT} services registered) Catalog : ${instance-CATALOG_STATUS} (${instance-CATALOG_COUNT} API tiles)

step.name: writeHealthReport
step.title: Write Health Report
step.description: Prints a formatted health report from all captured variables and exits non-zero if any probe returned a non-200 status
step.instructions:
Assembles and prints the consolidated APIML health report. The step exits RC=1 if any of the three probed services did not return HTTP 200, making the overall workflow step state Failed so the operator is alerted immediately.
Current summary: ${instance-HEALTH_SUMMARY}
